title: 26:20 Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers. The Lord invites us to enter our chambers while he destroys the wicked ("until the indignation pass over"). Chambers may refer to our homes and inner chambers, where we offer our prayers to our Father (Matt. 6:6) it may refer to the Lord's temples, where the righteous seek refuge from the world, or chambers may refer to the Lord himself, who is our "refuge from the storm" (25:4).
author: Tina M. Peterson
